criteria.criterion: apps/connect/index.html has one new <footer> element after the last existing section, containing exactly one line of text identifying the page as the focx design-system showcase.
criteria.evidence:
Read apps/connect/index.html on the checked-out run/run-20260902-022419-manual branch directly (not the pre-existing verdict's claims): lines 79-81 contain exactly one new
immediately after the last (the Confirmation actions section, line 78), containing exactly one

Focx design system — Connect showcase

line. Confirmed via independent `git diff develop...run/run-20260902-022419-manual -- apps/connect/index.html` (evidence/app-diff.txt), which shows only 3 added lines, no removals. Source-level verification only — the Render preview at PREVIEW_URL (https://focx-pr-30.onrender.com) was independently re-probed and found unreachable (see evidence/preview-unreachable.txt and the dedicated preview criterion below), so this could not be confirmed against the rendered page.

criteria.criterion: The footer has a top border using var(--border-hairline) as the width and var(--border-subtle) as the color, and no other decoration (no background, box-shadow, or border-radius).
criteria.evidence: apps/connect/styles.css lines 127-131: `.site-footer { margin-top: var(--control-px-lg); padding-top: var(--space-3); border-top: var(--border-hairline) solid var(--border-subtle); }`. Grepped design/tokens/focx/tokens.json and confirmed border-hairline resolves to 1px and border-subtle resolves to #ececec (both published tokens, not raw values in the CSS). No background, box-shadow, or border-radius property appears in the rule. Source-level only; the rendered result could not be confirmed (preview unreachable).

criteria.criterion: The footer's text is styled with font-size: var(--text-caption) and font-weight: var(--weight-regular), and no other font-size or font-weight rule applies to it.
criteria.evidence: apps/connect/styles.css lines 133-136: `.site-footer .caption { font-size: var(--text-caption); font-weight: var(--weight-regular); }`. Independently ran `grep -n "caption" apps/connect/styles.css` on the checked-out branch — the only match besides this new rule is the token definition `--text-caption: 12px` in :root; no pre-existing `.caption` class exists elsewhere. Inspected the universal `*` reset (line 40: box-sizing + margin only) and the `body` rule (lines 42-47: font-family, background, color, padding only) — neither sets font-size or font-weight, so no other rule competes. Source-level only; not confirmed rendered (preview unreachable).

criteria.criterion: The footer's spacing (its margin above the rule and padding between the rule and the text) uses only token values already defined in apps/connect/styles.css's :root block (e.g. var(--space-3), var(--control-px-lg)) — no new pixel literals anywhere in the diff.
criteria.evidence: `.site-footer` uses margin-top: var(--control-px-lg) and padding-top: var(--space-3); both are pre-existing :root entries (styles.css lines 16 and 24, confirmed by direct read of the file). evidence/app-diff.txt (independently generated via `git diff develop...run/run-20260902-022419-manual -- apps/connect/index.html apps/connect/styles.css`) shows every added line in both files, and none contains a raw pixel literal, hex value, or inline font name — only var(--...) references and markup.

criteria.criterion: No markup, class, or style outside the new footer changes in apps/connect/index.html or apps/connect/styles.css versus the pre-run committed version.
criteria.evidence: `git diff develop...run/run-20260902-022419-manual -- apps/connect/index.html apps/connect/styles.css`, independently run and saved to evidence/app-diff.txt, contains only added lines (no '-' lines) in both files: 3 lines appended to index.html (the new <footer>) and 11 lines appended to styles.css (the two new .site-footer rules). No existing selector, markup, or attribute was touched.

criteria.criterion: Design fidelity per 40-design-spec.json: cited tokens (focx.style.ui-caption via focx.text.caption/focx.weight.regular, focx.color.border-subtle, focx.border.hairline, focx.space.3, focx.control.px-lg) are the tokens actually used in the footer, and no component/decoration outside the spec was introduced.
criteria.evidence: Grepped design/tokens/focx/tokens.json directly and confirmed each cited token's CSS custom-property name matches what's consumed in the footer CSS: --weight-regular (fontWeight 400), --border-subtle (#ececec), --text-caption (fontSize 12px), --space-3 (6px), --control-px-lg (18px), --border-hairline (1px) — all present in :root and all referenced by var(...) in the new .site-footer rules, with no raw literals substituted. No dedicated Footer component exists in the Figma manifest per 40-design-spec.json's own notes, and the build correctly used the same discrete-sub-token pattern already established for the eyebrow style rather than inventing a component. Caveat: this is token-level source verification only — no Figma MCP access or reachable preview was available to this QA pass to perform a pixel-level visual comparison against the cited Figma node (fileKey GOlqIWU8MUzYZDQA39g6tv, node 9:7), so full visual design fidelity is unverified, not merely unconfirmed-but-assumed-fine.
